Claim 5 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of a method for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission, wherein said composition is in the form of a blocking vaccine to __impede__ and __prevent__ Leishmaniasis transmission.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): Use of the composition of claim 1 for preparation of a reagent, wherein the method of claim 4 further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission in __humans, dogs, or other animals__.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexosamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates: 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, __wherein the FML glycidic portion presents compositions in varying percentages of fucose, manose, glucose, galactose, and xylose.__
